_note: Short text choices. Outcome ops: hp_pct, mana_pct, gold, xp, potion, boon, item (rarity), chance {pct, win:[ops], lose:[ops]}, text.

drowned_altar.title: A drowned altar
drowned_altar.text: Black water fills a stone basin. Something glints at the bottom.

win.text: Your fingers close on something cold and well made.

hanged_peddler.title: A hanged peddler
hanged_peddler.text: A peddler's corpse turns slowly on a rope. His pack is still full.

whispering_skull.title: A whispering skull
whispering_skull.text: A skull on a spike murmurs a bargain: your blood for its secrets.

ops.text: Its secrets are mostly about killing.
Gold teeth scatter across the floor.

collapsed_armory.title: A collapsed armory
collapsed_armory.text: Racks of rusted gear lie under fallen stone.

ops.text: Most of it is ruined. Not all of it.

silent_well.title: A silent well
silent_well.text: No sound comes back when you drop a pebble.

win.text: The water is cold and clean.

lose.text: It tastes of iron and rot.

win.text: Two flasks float up out of the dark.

chained_prisoner.title: A chained prisoner
chained_prisoner.text: A gaunt figure in rusted chains begs you to free them.

win.text: They press a purse into your hand and flee.

lose.text: The chains were the only thing holding it back.

ops.text: Their pleading follows you down the hall.

bone_dice.title: A game of bone dice
bone_dice.text: Two corpses sit over a game that never finished.

win.text: You win. The corpses do not object.

lose.text: You lose. The dice were weighted.

ops.text: They're carved with tally marks of the dead.

old_campfire.title: An old campfire
old_campfire.text: Someone rested here not long ago. The embers are still warm.
